## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers how an authored image connects a DAM asset, the Core Image Component, responsive delivery and context-specific alternative text, then define the evidence required to review that contract on the Week 2 Guide Page.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 9 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Thursday, August 27, 2026. The audience understands Resources, Sling resolution, editable templates, policies, dialogs and persisted properties. This class connects the Week 2 Guide Page practice to asset references, Core Image behavior, accessible alternatives and browser delivery evidence.",
    "core_claim": "A reliable AEM image is a managed DAM reference delivered through proven component capability, given alternative text according to its purpose in the current context, and verified in the repository, rendered HTML and browser network trace.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "A DAM asset below /content/dam owns its binary, renditions and reusable metadata.",
      "An authored Image component below /content stores a fileReference to the DAM asset instead of copying the binary.",
      "A project proxy can inherit Core Image v3 with sling:resourceSuperType = core/wcm/components/image/v3/image when that version is installed.",
      "Core Image v3 provides browser-native responsive image delivery, lazy loading and authoring controls.",
      "Template authors configure allowed responsive widths and relevant defaults in the component policy or design dialog.",
      "Alternative text depends on the image's purpose in the current page context.",
      "Informative images need a meaningful non-empty alternative; decorative images require an explicit empty alt value.",
      "A missing alt attribute is not equivalent to an explicit empty alt value.",
      "Functional image alternatives describe the action or destination; complex images need a short alternative plus a detailed equivalent nearby.",
      "CSS sizing alone does not reduce transferred image bytes.",
      "Web-Optimized Image Delivery is an AEM as a Cloud Service option; local verification can use the Adaptive Image Servlet and browser network evidence.",
      "Incoming references should be inspected before moving, replacing, unpublishing or deleting a managed asset."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "DAM asset",
      "/content/dam",
      "fileReference",
      "Core Image Component v3",
      "core/wcm/components/image/v3/image",
      "component policy",
      "responsive candidates",
      "Adaptive Image Servlet",
      "Web-Optimized Image Delivery",
      "alt",
      "informative",
      "decorative",
      "functional",
      "complex",
      "incoming references"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "This is a passive closing slide. Participants may ask their own questions; the presenter must not ask scripted questions or introduce a review exercise."
  }
}
